tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Paper by day, night ground in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the top bar and bottom nav.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: Up next rows, inactive segments, file chips.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, and item-level buttons (Approve on a single decision, Act on one update).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text at 14px or larger: reasons, sources, authorship lines.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders and dividers.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Outlined buttons, plan-shape tags, input borders.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Brand. The ONE primary action per view (Pick up where I left off, Approve set, Send) and the current phase. Never for state.

tokens.name: on-ember
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ember.

tokens.name: ember-deep
tokens.usage: Link hover, confirmation text after an action, completed-phase marks.

tokens.name: ember-tint
tokens.usage: Background of the current phase on the rail.

tokens.name: today
tokens.usage: One thing for today, counts (3 for you), deadlines. Blue so it never competes with ember.

tokens.name: today-tint
tokens.usage: Background of today labels and count pills.

tokens.name: guardrail
tokens.usage: Guardrail chips (legal, medical, financial, tax, safety). Always paired with the shield icon and words.

tokens.name: guardrail-tint
tokens.usage: Background of guardrail chips; guardrail cards use it as a border tone.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Phase rail segment gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phone; gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Column gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page padding and section gaps on desktop.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable. Primary buttons use 48px.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, chips, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large sections: the checkpoint batch, the digest.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Count pills (3 for you) and quick-reply chips.
